question.worked_solution:
The logarithms share the same base, and so we can combine them using the product rule, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4\operatorname{log}⁡(5)+4\operatorname{log}⁡(x) & =8 \\ 4[\operatorname{log}⁡(5)+\operatorname{log}⁡(x)] & =8 \\ 4\operatorname{log}⁡(5x) & =8 \\ \operatorname{log}⁡(5x) & =\frac{8}{4} \\ \operatorname{log}⁡(5x) & =2\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we solve the equation for $x$ using the usual methods.

$$
\begin{aligned}{10}^{\operatorname{log}⁡(5x)} & ={10}^{2} \\ 5x & =100 \\ x & =20\end{aligned}
$$
